[quote=lavinsworth_united_islands;60049634]Mr. Achebe nods and leans back in his chair a little. "It's only precaution after all. You never know if a coup is gonna install an administration who hates you or plunges your neighbor into chaos. However, it's quite obvious that hasn't happened. I simply wish to ensure our two nations will continue being at the very least indifferent neighbors."

The worker comes back over and hands each order, glancing over at the recently arrived delegation.

"Would you gentlemen like anything?" she asks as confidently as she can in the face of an international delegation.[/quote]

President Khan gives an incredulous look to the waiter for their interruption. "No," he says flatly before turning back to the Lavian delegation.

"The coup was bloodless, organised, and handled without chaos. Why did you built up your forces on our border not long after the coup, in advance of our planned exercises, as if you were preparing to start an incursion?"

Minister Shari interjects as he sees President Khan's anger rise. "Our exercises were planned to be kept secret until they happened and the exercises themselves had been intended to be kept out of public knowledge. You should not have known. Yet you moved forces not immediately during or after the coup but a several days after." He leaves the implication that he suspects ULR of spying on Dhornaper hanging to see the Lavian delegation reaction.
